events.summary: Syr Damon sees the faces of the dragon's innocent victims and his sword blazes like the sun.
events.quote: Syr Damon looked at the dragon and saw the faces of every innocent it had devoured.

events.summary: Syr Tasdale declares he never wants to see the witch Ygretta again, and her familiars grant his wish.
events.quote: Syr Tasdale declared that he never wanted to see the witch Ygretta again.

events.summary: Syr Ameril faces dragonfire picturing Castle Ardenvale.
events.quote: As the blaze raced toward her, Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale so her last thoughts would be of home.

events.summary: Ellwen vanishes from her locked chamber.
events.quote: By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

events.summary: Cursed by the fae, Hilda is turned into a cow at the market.
events.quote: The fae curse was turning out even worse than she had feared.

events.summary: Korvold is transformed at his own wedding and eats the banquet, gifts and guests.
events.quote: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

events.summary: Ennor is cast out of Garenbrig and turns to fae magic to make a weapon for revenge.
events.quote: Cast out of Garenbrig for his crimes, Ennor turned to fae magic to fashion the perfect weapon for his revenge.

events.summary: Rowan and Will wonder whether a stag in a vision can lead them to their father.
events.quote: Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?

events.summary: The fae king Reynald's wish is answered by the fae king.
events.quote: Reynald wished for an army to sweep away his enemies.

relations.quote: If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it.

relations.note: Syr Tasdale is a knight of Ardenvale.
relations.quote: The edict of the Circle demands their voices be silenced.

relations.note: Her familiars removed him at his request.
relations.quote: Her familiars quickly granted his request.

relations.note: Ayara hopes her new suitor will bring the Cauldron home.
relations.quote: Hopefully, my new suitor will bring the Cauldron home.
